purpose: Specify exactly what Phase B freezes to disk, so that Stage 4 reads only the frozen substrate and never returns to the matrices after outcomes are visible.

WHY_THAT_IS_NOW_TRUE.S58: An earlier version of this contract introduced the R3 conditional reference while declaring itself statistically neutral. Those two things could not both be true: R3 fixes the reference distribution for 21 pairs, which is inferential semantics. The rule has been moved upstream into the statistical contract V3, where a reference distribution belongs and where it is auditable as a statistical choice.
WHY_THAT_IS_NOW_TRUE.consequence: this contract now only IMPLEMENTS rules frozen elsewhere, so the neutrality claim is true by construction rather than by assertion
WHY_THAT_IS_NOW_TRUE.enforced_by: every enumeration rule here must exist in the statistical contract by the same identifier; a cross-contract test checks it

statistical_contract.note: V3 is the authority for R1, R2 and R3

phase_B_MAY_compute: per-metacell normalised RNA for a gene (one modality)
per-metacell normalised ATAC for an interval's peak set (one modality)
donor-level means of either (the two V2 fields)
rna_depth_sensitivity and atac_depth_sensitivity, each a within-donor slope of one modality on that modality's own sequencing depth
phase_B_MAY_NOT_compute: the Pearson correlation between the RNA and ATAC vectors -- that IS the correspondence statistic and belongs to Stage 4
any disease or protected outcome association
THE_LINE_PHASE_B_MAY_NOT_CROSS.the_principle: Phase B may look at one modality at a time, or at a modality against its own depth. The moment two modalities are multiplied together, the experiment has been opened.

T1_METACELL_ASSIGNMENT.rule: k-means on the first 20 principal components of the within-donor RNA matrix, k = floor(n_microglia_donor / 25)
T1_METACELL_ASSIGNMENT.why_persisted: Stage 4 must use the identical partition. A partition rebuilt later would be rebuilt after outcomes were visible, and a partition is exactly the kind of choice that can move a correspondence result.

T2_METACELL_DEPTH.why: the two frozen depth-sensitivity nuisance terms are within-donor slopes on these totals, so Stage 4 cannot recompute them without these columns

T3_RNA_VECTORS.why: the frozen promoter_activity is the LINKED GENE's RNA. CONTROL_A and CONTROL_B differ from their linked edge only in the distal interval, so all three rows of an edge share one RNA vector. Keying by pair would duplicate it 8.5-fold with no added information.
T3_RNA_VECTORS.normalisation: sum of counts over the metacell's nuclei, divided by that metacell's total counts over all 38,606 genes, times 1e4, then log1p (CP10K log1p)

T4_ATAC_VECTORS.normalisation: sum of counts over the metacell's nuclei across the peak set assigned to the edge (below), divided by that metacell's total ATAC counts over all 521,217 peaks, times 1e4, then log1p
T4_ATAC_VECTORS.peak_assignment: All consensus peaks overlapping the E2 distal 5 kb hg38 interval by >= 1 bp are summed. No peak widening. No nearest-peak rescue. The number of overlapping peaks is recorded per edge.

T5_PAIR_DONOR_AGGREGATES.note: these are the V2 artifact's required donor-level fields; they are derived from T2-T4 and are stored as well as derivable so the V2 artifact is self-contained

T6_ENUMERATION_ONLY.reference_id_rule: a row materialised under R3 MUST carry the reference_id of its conditioning record in T7 and must resolve to exactly one such record. A row under R1 or R2 carries reference_rule_id but needs no conditioning record, because those references are unconditional.
T6_ENUMERATION_ONLY.label: ENUMERATION_ONLY
semantics: do NOT enter the primary population
exist solely to realise the already-frozen exact randomisation distribution
T6_ENUMERATION_ONLY.inherits: edge, promoter, donor and metacell structure from its edge
T6_ENUMERATION_ONLY.measured_identically_to: CONTROL_A and CONTROL_B, same code path

T7_R3_CONDITIONING_REFERENCE.why: statistical contract V3 requires the realised large-arm draw to be recorded per pair. Without it as DATA, Stage 4 would have to reconstruct which arm was large and what it drew -- after outcomes exist. Reconstructing a reference distribution once the answer is visible is exactly what this substrate freeze prevents.
T7_R3_CONDITIONING_REFERENCE.large_arm_is_not_redrawn: the realised large-arm draw is READ from the frozen Phase-A row, never re-sampled, so the conditioning record cannot drift from the population it conditions on
forbidden: deriving any R3 quantity without emitting its required_label
an R3 ENUMERATION_ONLY row with no resolvable reference_id
re-drawing or substituting the realised large-arm control

EXACT_ENUMERATION_REQUIREMENT.computed_from: the committed exact admissible sets, not assumed

RULE_SEMANTIC_DIGESTS.why: binding a rule by NAME alone cannot detect semantic drift: the eligibility or conditioning could change under an unchanged identifier and a name check would still pass. Each digest covers the canonical serialisation of that rule's full definition in the statistical contract, so any change on either side breaks the bind.

R1_primary_exact_A_side.rule: for every retained edge whose CONTROL_A support is 2-10, materialise ALL A-side admissible alternatives

R2_exact_joint_AB.rule: for a fully-randomised small-support A/B pair where BOTH arms have support <= 10, the reference is the EXACT JOINT distribution over the two side-specific admissible sets, so all alternatives of both arms are materialised

R3_exact_conditional_small_arm.rule: where exactly one arm has support <= 10 and the other is large, the reference is the EXACT CONDITIONAL distribution: the small arm is enumerated completely and the large arm is held at its realised draw
R3_exact_conditional_small_arm.why_not_the_full_joint: the large arms run to tens of thousands of admissible starts, so a full joint would require materialising measurements for tens of thousands of intervals per pair. The conditional reference is exact in a well-defined sense and is declared NOW rather than discovered when the cost became apparent.
R3_exact_conditional_small_arm.what_is_conditioned_on: the realised large-arm draw, recorded per pair

RECOVERABILITY_TEST_DONOR_FIREWALL_SCOPE.CORRECTION: An earlier audit note of mine said Phase B would not authorise 'any use of the paired NIH-CARD TEST donors'. That wording conflated two different experiments and is withdrawn.

what_the_split_actually_governs.split: 16 TRAIN / 4 VALIDATION / 4 TEST, donor ID only, seed 20260930
what_the_split_actually_governs.restriction: the 4 TEST donors are forbidden for recoverability model, rank, basis, rotation or threshold selection

what_governs_Phase_B.authority: the correspondence design contract's own donor-population rules
what_governs_Phase_B.statement: Phase B follows this authority. The recoverability split does not remove donors from it.

RECOVERABILITY_TEST_DONOR_FIREWALL_SCOPE.if_global_sequestration_is_wanted: that must be an EXPLICIT prospective amendment, with its impact on the Phase-B donor population measured and reported before adoption. It may not arrive as a side effect of architecture work on a different experiment.
RECOVERABILITY_TEST_DONOR_FIREWALL_SCOPE.why_this_matters: silently dropping four donors would change the Phase-B population for a reason unrelated to Phase B, and the change would be invisible in the Phase-B receipt.

DONOR_POPULATION_MEASURED_FROM_LAWFUL_ME.why: Age, Sex, Ancestry, Ethnicity, Race, PMI and Brain_bank are protected demographic attributes. Donor identity and cell type are the only columns needed to define the aggregation population.
DONOR_POPULATION_MEASURED_FROM_LAWFUL_ME.agreement_with_design_contract: 75 of 357 donors have fewer than 100 microglia, so approximately 282 donors are expected to qualify. The executor must recompute this from the authenticated bytes and report the actual number.

SUBSTRATE_SCALE_MEASURED.note: T3 is gene-keyed, which is 8.5x smaller than a pair-keyed layout with no information loss

inherited_rules.zero_coverage: If the gene has zero RNA counts in ALL of a donor's metacells, or the assigned peak set has zero ATAC counts in ALL of them, the correlation is UNDEFINED. That (donor, pair) cell is recorded as MISSING. It is NEVER recorded as zero: zero would assert an observed absence of correspondence where there was no measurement.
inherited_rules.degenerate_variance: If either vector has zero variance across a donor's metacells, the cell is MISSING for the same reason.

MISSINGNESS_IN_THE_SUBSTRATE.representation: per-element availability columns in T3 and T4, and an availability_state in T5 drawn from the four frozen states
MISSINGNESS_IN_THE_SUBSTRATE.forbidden: writing 0 for an unmeasured value in any table

depth_sensitivity_definitions.rna: within-donor slope of the gene's metacell RNA value on metacell total RNA counts
depth_sensitivity_definitions.atac: within-donor slope of the peak set's metacell ATAC value on metacell total ATAC counts

NUISANCE_TERMS_THE_SUBSTRATE_MUST_SUPPOR.note: both depth terms are single-modality slopes on that modality's own sequencing depth, so computing them does not open the correspondence

PROVENANCE_THE_PHASE_B_RECEIPT_MUST_BIND: producer path, sha256 and git blob
every emitted substrate table: path, bytes, sha256
the metacell assignment artifact sha256, separately
the R3 conditioning reference artifact sha256
the semantic digest of every enumeration rule implemented
NIH-CARD RNA and ATAC byte-authentication receipt and pairing closeout
every frozen constant and seed actually used
the obs columns read, and the protected columns not read
STOP_CONDITIONS: any substrate table cannot be emitted
any availability value would have to be written as 0
the metacell partition cannot be persisted and hash-bound
the enumeration set cannot be materialised in full
the consensus peak build fails the hg38 precondition
any protected obs column is read
an R3 ENUMERATION_ONLY row cannot resolve its reference_id
a rule semantic digest disagrees with the statistical contract
an R3-derived quantity is emitted without its conditional label
